rationale: Minimized cost by maximizing inverter active power (20 MW) to reduce diesel usage, and setting diesel reactive power to preferred value (4 MVAr) to avoid penalty. Voltage computed as 0.965 + 0.0025*(4+8) = 0.995 pu, within limits. Inverter apparent power sqrt(20^2+8^2)=21.54 MVA <= 24 MVA rating.
